leadText: Nicholas Corda is a voice actor for the English-language dub of . He is currently affiliated with CESD Talent Agency and Impressive Talent Casting Agency.
plainText:
Nicholas Corda is a voice actor for the English-language dub of . He is currently affiliated with CESD Talent Agency and Impressive Talent Casting Agency.

==Biography==
Corda was born on July 7, 1992, and grew up on Long Island. He became a voice actor as an adult and joined the during , where he voiced 's older brother Ulu. He currently lives in New York City.

==Pokémon roles==
===Animation===
==== ====
Ulu

Crowd Walla (SM128, SM130)

==Other non-Pokémon roles==
Father, Toad, Dog, Fox, Emperor, Doctor (Grimm, Grimmer, Grimmest)
LAXX (Beat)
Senecio (Apollo's Tall Tales)
Dad, Announcer, Clownfish, Bat (Kyle's Wild World)
Wade Johnson, Intro Narrator ( )
Announcer (T2-D2 Amazon Alexa Spot)
Tula Han, Streibough (Live A Live)
